docs.text: The sea smoke on Lake Superior this morning was wild. Grand Marais, Minnesota
The Paul R. Tregurtha and the waves of Lake Superior near Two Harbors, Minnesota, 29 December, 2025. Photo by Adam Malmanger.
The lift bridge in Duluth emerges from the fog on Lake Superior, 12 May, 2023. Photo by Ken Harmon.
The commercial fishing boat (there's one remaining commercial fishery in Grand Marais) leaves that harbor this morning before sunrise. It was 15°F (-9°C).
The Lake Walk, a lakeside walking trail in Duluth, MN that overlooks Lake Superior. Shot in October 2024.
The Duluth North Pierhead Light, one of three lights marking the entrance to the Duluth Ship Canal on Lake Superior the morning of 27 March, 2025. Photo by Joe Polecheck Photography
The Paul R. Tregurtha sails towards the sunset on Lake Superior, 19 May, 2024. Photo by Andrew Dean.
Sea smoke around a peninsula in Michigan’s Boreal Forest along Lake Superior just after sunrise, 12 February, 2023. Photo by Ken Harmon. Superior
The sea smoke coming off Lake Superior at Two Harbours is mad looking. Cold air and warmer water causes it. See
Subzero temps bring on the Lake Superior sea smoke, 30 January, 2023. Photo courtesy of North On 53 Photography.
This morning on the St. Clair River: the Paul R. Tregurtha by Marysville making her way up from St. Clair towards Duluth, 15 August, 2025. Photo by Doug Dumas. .ClairRiver
Frigid air creates billowing sea on a snowy Lake Superior shoreline, 3 February, 2023. Photo courtesy of Ken Harmon Photography.

Sunrise plumes: the Lee A. Tregurtha leaves Superior for Silver Bay as the American Spirit returns to anchor after an aborted attempt to dock in Two Harbors due to wind and waves, 3 November, 2025. Photo by David Schauer. “Both vessels use heavy fuel pollution scrubbers, hence the steam plumes (mostly water vapor).” - David Schauer
Just after sunrise at the Duluth North Pierhead Light on Lake Superior, 28 March, 2022. Photo by Nicholas J. Narog Photography.
Sunrise and “sea smoke” over Lake Superior at Duluth, 15 November, 2024. Drone photography by David Schauer.

A day at the lake in Duluth: with folks on their boats watching and the Netherlands-registered Beatrix at anchor, the Canadian Snowbirds aerial demonstration team does a fly over, 31 July, 2024. Photo by Gus Schauer.

Meanwhile, Saturday arrives in Duluth: the sunrise over Lake Superior, 2 March, 2024. Photo by Paul Scinocca. “Shot was taken from the 3rd street Observation Park overlook.” - photographer Paul Scinocca.

SEA SMOKE...AND A WATERSPOUT? A viewer shared with me their view of the "" that took place last Saturday on . A closer look shows a...possible ? I'm not too familiar with cold weather waterspouts, but it does look like it. What do you think?

As sea smoke forms over Lake Superior with temperatures in the zero degree range and wind chill at 20 below zero, the Paul R. Tregurtha cruises upbound past Whitefish Point, 16 January, 2024. Photo by Frances Czapski.
The Lee A. Tregurtha sailing on Lake Superior, 26 May, 2023. Photos by Andrew Dean.
Morning anglers on Lake Superior watch two ore carriers, the Edgar B. Speer followed by the Walter J. McCarthy, come into Duluth, 12 May, 2019. Photo by Jan Swart.
At least it was sunny: with sea smoke billowing in the background over Lake Superior, the Philip R. Clarke enters icy Duluth Harbor in sub-zero conditions, 13 January, 2025. Photo by Nathan Klok.
Massive amounts of sea smoke in subzero temperatures at Minnesota’s Two Harbors Lighthouse Museum on Lake Superior earlier this month. Photo by Don J. Olson.
A -10 degree morning at Two Harbors, Minnesota, 13 January, 2025. Photo by David Schauer. “Museum tug Edna G. and the John J. Boland with an ample display of sea smoke over the lake.” - David Schauer

Today's photo is actually a video. The lifting bridge, Duluth, by night. It was taken on a balmy evening in September, 2012 and shows the lifting bridge in Duluth, raised to allow passage of a freighter. We were on the lake for a wedding eve supper (Jill and Mitch!!!). Among the happiest of days.
Sea Smoke is covering the big lake like a blanket. It's a good indicator of wanting to wallow in the warm blankets and sleep in.

Warning signs of oil slick on the unusually calm waters of at in just before sunrise this morning. There are no clouds in the sky. What you are seeing on the water is oil from personal and cruise boats.
Wondering what is on fire in along the shore of the plume was big.

I know I shared with you a photo of the Oberstar taken earlier today but this one from the archives of the same ship taken by the same photographer was a little hard to pass up: some autumn color as the James L. Oberstar sails on the St. Louis River after unloading limestone at C. Reiss in West Duluth, 12 October, 2021. Photo by David Schauer.
The Arthur M. Anderson and a surfer rode in with the Lake Superior waves at Duluth this morning, 14 April, 2023. Photo by David Schauer.

Sea Smoke over Minnesota’s Grand Marais lighthouse, 17 January, 2024. Photo by Bryan Hansel. “I love Lake Superior when it does this! I wish it would stay this cold for this month and all of February.” - photographer Bryan Hansel

A lone fisherman at sunrise in Duluth, 21 April, 2021. Photo by Adam Bjornberg. “Went down to Canal Park this morning in hopes of a sunrise. After first looks were looking poor we did get this explosion of color for a few minutes until the sun went behind the clouds. Enjoy moments like this while most others are still asleep.” - photographer Adam Bjornberg
Sunrise arrival in Duluth of the Great Lakes cruise ship Viking Octantis, 8 July, 2024. Photo by Stephanie Irwin.

At anchor on Lake Superior, the “salties” Volgaborg and Vlieborg, both registered in the Netherlands, with the Duluth Central High School clock tower in the foreground, 22 September, 2024. Photo by David Schauer.

The “saltie” Flevogracht, registered in the Netherlands, departs Duluth empty, headed for Sept-Isle, Québec, 29 April, 2025. Photo by Adam Bjornberg. “Nothing but sunshine this afternoon here on the western side of Lake Superior.” - Adam Bjornberg

A smoky sunset over Fraser Shipyards in Superior, 29 July, 2025. Photo by David Schauer. “No word on the Michipicoten but its return to service is unlikely. Oberstar is undergoing hull repair after grounding in the St. Marys River and will likely be here for a while.” - David Schauer
